content:
Track: Introduction to Data Analysis with Python
    - Lesson 1: Setting up Python Environment for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 2: Exploring and Manipulating Data in Pandas
    - Lesson 3: Working with CSV, Excel, and SQL databases using Pandas
    - Lesson 4: Introduction to Data Cleaning Techniques
    - Lesson 5: Handling Missing Values and Outliers
    - Lesson 6: Data Visualization Basics with Matplotlib
    - Lesson 7: Advanced Data Visualization Techniques with Seaborn
    - Lesson 8: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
    - Lesson 9: Introduction to Statistical Analysis with Python
    - Lesson 10: Applying Statistical Tests and Interpreting Results

  Track: SQL Foundations
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: Joins, UNION, and Subqueries
    - Lesson 4: Aggregation Functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG, etc.)
    - Lesson 5: WHERE Clause and Conditional Statements
    - Lesson 6: ORDER BY and GROUP BY Clauses
    - Lesson 7: Advanced SQL Techniques (CASE WHEN, JOINs with subqueries, etc.)
    - Lesson 8: Working with Real-world Databases
    - Lesson 9: Optimizing SQL Queries for Performance
    - Lesson 10: Database Normalization and Design

  Track: Data Cleaning and Wrangling
    - Lesson 1: Handling Duplicates in Data
    - Lesson 2: Removing or Replacing Missing Values
    - Lesson 3: Data Imputation Techniques
    - Lesson 4: Transforming Data with Functional Programming
    - Lesson 5: Merging and Concatenating Multiple Datasets
    - Lesson 6: Handling Date and Time Data in Python
    - Lesson 7: Text Preprocessing and Cleaning Techniques
    - Lesson 8: Feature Engineering for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 9: Handling Categorical Data with One-Hot Encoding
    - Lesson 10: Dimensionality Reduction Techniques (PCA, t-SNE)

  Track: Data Aggregation and Statistics
    - Lesson 1: Descriptive Statistics in Python
    - Lesson 2: Measures of Central Tendency (Mean, Median, Mode)
    - Lesson 3: Measures of Dispersion (Variance, Standard Deviation)
    - Lesson 4: Correlation and Covariance Analysis
    - Lesson 5: Hypothesis Testing: t-test and Chi-square test
    - Lesson 6: Confidence Intervals and Margins of Error
    - Lesson 7: Probability Distributions (Normal, Binomial, Poisson)
    - Lesson 8: Linear Regression Analysis with Python
    - Lesson 9: Logistic Regression for Binary Outcomes
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Machine Learning Algorithms

  Track: Data Visualization and Storytelling
    - Lesson 1: Choosing the Right Chart for Your Data
    - Lesson 2: Enhancing Data Visualizations with Style and Aesthetics
    - Lesson 3: Creating Multiple Plot Types (Scatter, Bar, Area, etc.)
    - Lesson 4: Interactive Visualization Libraries (Bokeh, Plotly Dash)
    - Lesson 5: Storytelling with Data Dashboards and Reports
    - Lesson 6: Communicating Insights Effectively in Presentations
    - Lesson 7: Creating Infographics and Reports for Non-Technical Audiences
    - Lesson 8: Crafting a Compelling Data Story
    - Lesson 9: Data Visualization Best Practices and Guidelines
    - Lesson 10: Sharing Your Work and Getting Feedback

  Track: Introduction to Machine Learning
    - Lesson 1: Supervised Learning Algorithms (Regression, Classification)
    - Lesson 2: Unsupervised Learning Algorithms (Clustering, Dimensionality Reduction)
    - Lesson 3: Evaluating Model Performance with Metrics and Cross-Validation
    - Lesson 4: Overfitting, Underfitting, and Regularization Techniques
    - Lesson 5: Feature Selection Techniques for Improved Models
    - Lesson 6: Ensemble Methods (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting)
    - Lesson 7: Deep Learning Foundations (Neural Networks, Convolutional Neural Networks)
    - Lesson 8: Natural Language Processing Techniques with Python
    - Lesson 9: Building a Complete Machine Learning Pipeline
    - Lesson 10: Applying Machine Learning to Real-world Problems
